india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Assam–Tibet earthquake
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Very large 1950 Himalayan event that affected NE India.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: 1964 Rameswaram Cyclone (regional storms era)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Representative major coastal cyclone in the 1960s era (sources vary); included to represent cyclone risk in that decade.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Koyna earthquake
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Strong intraplate earthquake associated with reservoir-induced seismicity in Koyna region.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: 1970s large-scale droughts (Decadal event)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Periodic severe drought episodes in early 1970s impacting agriculture and livelihoods.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: 1977 Andhra Pradesh Cyclone (1977 super cyclone)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: One of the deadliest cyclones to hit the Andhra coast in the 1970s era (high uncertainty in fatality counts).

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: 1981 / 1982 major floods (representative)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Severe monsoon flood seasons in early 1980s; consolidated EM-DAT lists show multi-state flood disasters.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Kozhikode (Calicut) / Kerala flood events (1980s–1990s)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Major regional floods that frequently impacted Kerala during monsoon decades.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Latur (Killari) earthquake
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Highly destructive intraplate earthquake in Maharashtra (Killari), major fatalities and village destruction.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Uttarkashi earthquake
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Major Himalayan earthquake causing loss of life and damage across Uttarkashi region.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Super Cyclone (1999 Odisha Super Cyclone)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: One of the most destructive cyclones in Indian history; massive damage to life, housing and agriculture.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Gujarat (Bhuj) earthquake
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Devastating 2001 Gujarat earthquake with very high fatalities and infrastructure collapse.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Indian Ocean Tsunami
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.location: Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Pondicherry
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: 2004 tsunami caused by the Sumatra quake — heavy loss in Indian coastal states and islands.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Kashmir Earthquake (2005 South Asia earthquake)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: 2005 Kashmir earthquake affected Pakistan and India; very high fatalities (figures often combine Pakistan/India).

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Cyclone Aila
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.location: West Bengal, Odisha, Bangladesh border area (Sunderbans)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Severe coastal storm causing flooding and damage across Sunderbans and coastal districts.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Bihar Floods
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Severe state-level flood in 2007 affecting millions across Bihar.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Cyclone Phailin
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Very large cyclone with successful mass evacuations that reduced fatalities compared to historical cyclones.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Uttarakhand Flash Floods / Kedarnath tragedy
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Severe flash floods and landslides in June 2013 causing heavy casualties and huge rescue operations.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Kerala Floods (major 2013–2014 episodes included 2014 earlier floods)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.location: Kashmir (2014 floods) and earlier Kerala 2013/2014 floods
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: 2014 Kashmir floods (September 2014) and Kerala recurring flood episodes across the period; included for late period representation.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Malpa Landslide
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Major landslide in Himalayan region causing many fatalities among pilgrims and locals.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Bhopal Gas Tragedy (industrial disaster)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Union Carbide gas leak — largest industrial disaster with long-term health and environmental impacts.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Maharashtra (Panshet/Koyna) reservoir-linked seismicity / heavy floods (representative)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Representative dam/reservoir related catastrophic flooding events in mid-20th century Maharashtra.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Orissa Supercyclone (other major cyclones earlier than 1999)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Selected major coastal cyclones in the 1970s–1980s to represent recurring cyclone hazard.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Severe heat wave episodes (1980s / 1998 / 2003 included)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: 2003 heat wave and other severe heat episodes caused large numbers of excess deaths (estimates vary).

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Mizoram earthquake / NE states seismic events (representative)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Significant seismic events in NE India included for regional coverage.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Cyclone Phailin precursor / 1999–2004 cyclone seasons (selected)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Included major 1999 supercyclone (already in list) and other severe cyclones in the era.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Bihar Drought / Famines (recurring historical drought episodes)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Representative major drought/famine episodes in mid-20th century India.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Chennai / Tamil Nadu floods (2005–2006 & 2015 later; included 2005 major flood)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Major urban flood episodes included to represent highly urbanised flood risk.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Sikkim Glacial Lake Outburst / Teesta floods (representative)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Representative high-mountain flooding events including GLOF risks in Himalayan states.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Avalanches and landslides (Malpa 1998 already included) – other Himalayan slump events
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Representative major slope-failure disasters in mountainous regions.

india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.name: Major multi-state monsoon floods (1980s–early 1990s representative event)
india_historical_disasters_1950_2014.notes: Representative severe monsoon seasons that produced multi-state humanitarian crises throughout the period.
